title: Protocol to desensitize human and murine mast cells after polyclonal IgE sensitization
protocol: Collect BMMCs from a 100 mm × 20 mm cell culture dish into a Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 486 g modifying acceleration/deceleration settings for low brake (e.g., level 3 of 9) and medium acceleration (e.g., level 7 of 9) for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Discard supernatant.
Suspend cell pellet in 1 ml of IMDM culture media.
Perform cell counting and assess cell viability.
Add murine polyclonal IgE sera at a concentration range of 1–10 ng/mL.
Seed the cells in a 6- or 24-well cell culture plate.
Characterize PN-sIgE levels before sensitizing BMMCs.
Leave BMMCs approximately 16 hours at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Collect sensitized BMMCs.
Spin cells at 486 g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Discard supernatant.
Suspend pelleted BMMCs in supplemented IMDM desensitization media to achieve a cellularity of 1.22 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Seed 0.1 × 10^6 BMMCs in 82 μL in a U/V-bottom 96 well plate.
Carry out the desensitization protocol adding 2 μL of PN solution at the corresponding concentration every 10 min.
Spin cells at 486 g at maximal acceleration and low brake for 5 min at 20°C–25°C after 5 days.
Discard supernatant.
Suspend cell pellet in 1 mL of StemPro-34 culture media and r-hIL4 at 10 ng/mL.
Perform cell counting and assess cell viability.
Ensure viability is >85%.
Resuspend LAD2 cells in supplemented StemPro-34 + r-hIL4 at 10 ng/mL to reach the adequate sensitization cellularity.
Add specific volume of polyclonal sIgEs.
Sensitize LAD2 cells with 100 ng/mL of hIgE.
Sensitize cells with chosen concentration of PN-allergic donor sera.
Seed the cells in a 6- or 24-well plate depending on the final volume obtained.
Test degranulation of LAD2 cells by flow cytometry or β-hexosaminidase activity.
Evaluate total PN-sIgE levels (kUA/mL).
Sensitize LAD2 cells with different PN-sIgE sera dilutions to induce a maximal LAD2 degranulating response of approximately 40% at a concentration of about 10 kUA/mL.
Incubate sensitized LAD2 cells for 16 hours at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Collect the sensitized LAD2 cells.
Spin the collected cells at 486 g with maximal acceleration and low brake (e.g., level 3 of 9) for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Suspend the cells in supplemented StemPro-34 media.
Seed 0.05 × 10^6 LAD2 cells in each well of a U/V-bottom 96-well plate in either 86 μL or 82 μL, depending on the desensitization protocol performed.
Seed LAD2 cells in a volume of 86 μL for hIgE desensitization protocol.
Add 2 μL of anti-hIgE or PN every 10 min according to the corresponding concentration for each step in the desensitization protocol.
Seed LAD2 cells in a volume of 82 μL for PN desensitization protocol.
